title: Similar structures under Menkaure (2+2) and the Sphinx (one)
place_text: Menkaure pyramid and Sphinx, Giza, Egypt

tellings.quote: that we found in Khafre we found the same thing also in Menkaure and also under the Sphinx.

plain: The hidden structures found under Khafre, one of the three great pyramids at Giza in Egypt, turn up under the smaller pyramid of Menkaure too, two pairs of them, and one more under the Sphinx. That is what the scientist Filippo Biondi says. He scanned the ground beneath the pyramids himself and tells Michels, about the 2025 work, "we found the same thing also in Menkaure and also under the Sphinx." If true, it would point to one planned network of buildings underground across the whole site.
